seoTitle: Credit Note Generator: Printable and Linked to Invoice
metaDescription: Create a printable credit note that names the original invoice and credits lines with negative amounts and VAT per rate.
intro: A printable credit note with negative amounts and a VAT summary.
why:
A credit note corrects or cancels an invoice. It should name the original invoice and show the credited amounts and VAT.

Fill in your details and the credited lines. The preview uses negative amounts grouped by VAT rate, ready to print or save as PDF with your browser.
howTo: Enter your details, the customer, the credit note number and the original invoice.
Add credited lines as description, quantity, price, VAT percent.

faq.a: Many countries expect one. A field is included.
